description_zh: 创建一个手动备份任务
name: CreateBackupJob

parameters.help_en: The name of the backup job
parameters.name: job_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the data source. Valid values:
UDM_ECS: ECS instance backup
parameters.help_zh:
数据源类型，取值范围：
UDM_ECS：表示ECS整机备份
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en: The retention period of the backup, in days
parameters.name: retention

parameters.help_en: This parameter is required when SourceType is set to UDM_ECS. The ECS instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
当SourceType取值为UDM_ECS时，需要配置该参数。
表示ECS实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.example:
{
    "doCopy": false,
    "destinationRegionId": "",
    "destinationRetention": null,
    "diskIdList": [],
    "snapshotGroup": false,
    "appConsistent": false,
    "enableWriters": true,
    "preScriptPath": "",
    "postScriptPath": "",
    "enableFsFreeze": true,
    "timeoutInSeconds": 60
}
parameters.help_en:
The detail configurations. This parameter is required when SourceType is set to UDM_ECS.
The value is a JSON character string.

doCopy: Specifies whether to enable cross-region replication.
destinationRegionId: The destination region for cross-region replication.
destinationRetention: The retention period of cross-region copy backup points.
diskIdList: The list of cloud disk IDs to back up. If this parameter is left empty, all cloud disks are backed up.
snapshotGroup: Specifies whether to use a consistent snapshot group. This takes effect only when all cloud disks of the instance are ESSDs.
appConsistent: Specifies whether to enable application consistency. This parameter must be used together with the preScriptPath and postScriptPath parameters.
preScriptPath: The path of the pre-freeze script.
postScriptPath: The path of the post-thaw script.
enableWriters: This parameter is required only when AppConsistent is set to true. Specifies whether to apply the Settings for application-consistent snapshots. Default value: true.
true: creates an application-consistent snapshot.
false: creates a file system-consistent snapshot.
enableFsFreeze: This parameter is required only when AppConsistent is set to true. Specifies whether to use the FsFreeze mechanism of Linux to ensure the read consistency of the file system in read-only mode before creating an application-consistent snapshot. Default value: true.
timeoutSeconds: This parameter is required only when AppConsistent is set to true. The I/O freeze timeout period. Default value: 30. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh:
当SourceType取值为UDM_ECS时，需要配置该参数。
类型为JSON字符串。

doCopy：是否开启异地复制
destinationRegionId：异地复制目标地域
destinationRetention：异地复制备份点保留时间
diskIdList：备份的云盘ID列表，为空时备份全部云盘。
snapshotGroup：是否使用一致性快照组（仅实例所有云盘均为ESSD时有效）。
appConsistent：是否使用应用一致性（需要搭配参数preScriptPath和postScriptPath使用）。
preScriptPath：冻结脚本路径。
postScriptPath：解冻脚本路径。
enableWriters：仅当AppConsistent为true时，需要配置该参数。是否设置应用一致性快照（默认为 true）：
true：创建应用一致性快照
false：创建文件系统一致性快照
enableFsFreeze：仅当AppConsistent为true时，需要配置该参数。是否在创建应用一致性快照前使用 Linux 的 FsFreeze 机制确保文件系统处于只读一致性。默认为 true。
timeoutSeconds：仅当AppConsistent为true时，需要配置该参数。IO 冻结超时时间。默认为 30 秒
parameters.name: detail

parameters.help_en:
The backup type. This parameter is required when SourceType is set to UDM_ECS. Valid values:
COMPLETE: full backup
parameters.help_zh:
备份类型。当SourceType取值为UDM_ECS时，需要配置该参数。
COMPLETE：全量备份
parameters.name: backup_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the backup vault.
This parameter is not required when SourceType is set to UDM_ECS
parameters.help_zh:
备份仓库ID。
当SourceType取值为UDM_ECS时，不需要配置该参数
parameters.name: vault_id

parameters.help_en:
The backup traffic throttling. This parameter does not take effect when SourceType is set to UDM_ECS. The format is `{start}|{end}|{bandwidth}`. Separate multiple bandwidth limit configurations with vertical bars (|). The time periods of different configurations cannot overlap.

start: The start hour.
end: The end hour.
bandwidth: The bandwidth limit. Unit: KB/s
parameters.help_zh:
当SourceType取值为UDM_ECS时，该参数不生效。
表示备份流量控制。格式为`{start}|{end}|{bandwidth}`。多个流量控制配置使用|分隔，并且配置时间不允许有重叠。

start：起始小时。
end：结束小时。
bandwidth：限制速率，单位KB/s
parameters.name: speed_limit

parameters.help_en: The paths to back up. All files in the specified paths are backed up. This parameter does not take effect when SourceType is set to UDM_ECS. The value can be up to 255 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
当SourceType取值为UDM_ECS时，该参数不生效。
表示需要备份的路径，该路径下所有文件都备份。最多支持255个字符
parameters.name: include

parameters.help_en: The paths to exclude from the backup. All files in the specified paths are not backed up. This parameter does not take effect when SourceType is set to UDM_ECS. The value can be up to 255 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
当SourceType取值为UDM_ECS时，该参数不生效。
表示不需要进行备份的路径，该路径下所有文件都不备份。最多支持255个字符
parameters.name: exclude

parameters.help_en: Set this parameter to false or leave it empty
parameters.name: initiated_by_ack

parameters.help_en:
The cross-account backup type. Valid values: 
SELF_ACCOUNT: current account backup
CROSS_ACCOUNT: cross-account backup
parameters.help_zh:
跨账号备份类型。支持： 
SELF_ACCOUNT：本账号备份
CROSS_ACCOUNT：跨账号备份
parameters.name: cross_account_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source account for the cross-account backup managed by the current account
parameters.help_zh: 被当前账号管理的跨账号备份的原账号ID
parameters.name: cross_account_user_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the RAM role created in the source account for the cross-account backup managed by the current account
parameters.help_zh: 被当前账号管理的跨账号备份的原账号RAM中创建的角色名
parameters.name: cross_account_role_name

Code.description_en: The return code. A value of 200 indicates success

JobId.description_en: The ID of the backup job

Message.description_en: The return message. A value of successful indicates success. If an error occurs, the corresponding error message is returned
Message.description_zh: 返回信息描述，成功一般返回successful，错误时会返回相应错误信息

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。

true：成功。
false：失败
